changes.reason: The build-time CLI now emits an explicit bootstrap-only Workers application. These package decisions concern the Tooling process, which does not execute an application Host; emitted application behavior remains infrastructure-dependent and its native Workers adapter is reviewed separately below.

kubernetes.reason: The generator is build-time Tooling rather than a Kubernetes Node Host. Existing generated Node deployment composition is preserved; this change introduces no Kubernetes provider or cluster lifecycle.
constraints: Do not treat the CLI runtime snapshot as a generated application runtime claim.
Generated Kubernetes Node Host validation and real cluster certification are separate.

aws-lambda.reason: The generator is not invoked as a Lambda application Host and owns no invocation resource or flush boundary. Existing Lambda API generation remains separate from the bootstrap-only Workers composition.
constraints: Do not promote the documentation-only full SaaS Lambda profile to executable support.
Generated Lambda invocation scope, reuse, flush and live AWS evidence remain application Host responsibilities.

cloudflare.reason: The CLI emits Worker sources but is not deployed inside a Worker isolate. Its catalog runtime list remains unclaimed. The emitted application selects the conditional native Workers adapter reviewed in preset-cloudflare.
constraints: Generated saas-cloudflare is bootstrap-only; all eight SaaS business capabilities are unavailable.
Generated Workers require nodejs_compat, native env bindings and a fresh request context.
Retain actual Wrangler/workerd generated smoke; Node unit tests and the review record do not certify Cloudflare deployment.

changes.reason: The opt-in application entrypoint supplies an alpha native-env Host plugin for an application-owned initialized graph without installing or certifying SaaS providers.

kubernetes.reason: This native Worker env/fetch Host is not a Kubernetes Node Host and introduces no Node server lifecycle adapter.
constraints: Select the existing Node Host deployment path separately; no Kubernetes cluster support or certification is asserted.

aws-lambda.reason: This entrypoint does not implement the Lambda event/context Host or invocation completion boundary.
constraints: Select a Lambda Host separately and retain invocation-scoped resource and flush ownership; no AWS certification is asserted.

cloudflare.reason: The alpha native env binding plugin participates in the existing Workers fetch Host and initialized ApplicationRuntime. Support is limited to this explicit bootstrap/runtime.host boundary.
constraints: Workers host only; not a Cloudflare Node Container.
Requires nodejs_compat for callback and request context isolation.
Native env identity owns the application runtime; do not serialize secret binding values into the graph.
Generated SaaS bootstrap provides health and explicit unavailable Problems, not the eight SaaS business providers or durable storage.
Actual Wrangler/workerd smoke remains required separately; Node env-ownership unit tests are not Workers execution receipts.
No live Cloudflare account, production deployment, vendor provider certification or npm release is claimed.
